title: BAFU 2026 v1 elementary flows → EF 3.1 flows without a characterization factor (nomenclature alignment)
description: Fourth bafu-2026-v1 → ef-3.1 bridge, ranked below ranks 3, 6 and 7; holds only flows none of them maps. Every target is an EF 3.1 elementary flow that exists in the EF nomenclature (sentier-vocab) but carries no characterization factor in any of the 25 EF 3.1 methods (sentier-methods), so the impact contribution of every entry is zero by construction; the bridge aligns names, not scores. Generated by sentier-importers (sources/bafu/mappings_biosphere_nomenclature) with the same matching as rank 7 on the EF index that includes uncharacterised flows. Because the EF vocab carries no context path for those flows, their sub-compartment is inferred from the Brightway context code sentier-vocab stores on every EF row (matching/bw_context.py, a crosswalk derived from the factor-bearing flows on 2026-09-13); entries whose code is ambiguous say so in their comment, and the six converted-energy resource flows (geothermal, solar, wind, hydropower, biomass energy) carry no target context at all because EF's context is not recoverable from the source context code (decision 2026-09-13). Two further relaxations, rank 8 only and each commented: a flow whose EF namesakes all lack a factor is placed on the unspecified leaf of its compartment, or on its sole EF leaf, when its own sub-compartment does not exist in EF (nomenclature_placement, 13 entries); and BAFU's standing-wood and unspecified-water resources are aliased onto EF's factorless Wood and Water. Target units are the EF spelling of the BAFU unit's dimension (kilogram, kBq with a Bq→kBq factor, cubic meter, megajoule, m2, m2*a), since EF's reference unit is unknowable without a factor. Every entry's comment starts with 'uncharacterised in EF 3.1: no factor in any method'. Decision Laurenz 2026-09-13. Regenerate after rank 7, with a fresh --cache-dir: python -m sentier_importers run bafu-ef-biosphere-nomenclature --deliver-local ~/dds/sentier-mappings.
